mapper.select: SELECT orders.order_id, users.username, orders.order_status, orders.total_purchase_price, orders.create_time, orders.checkout_time, orders.refund_time, order_items.order_item_id, order_items.order_id as order_item_id_order_id, order_items.product_id, order_items.product_name, order_items.franchise_name, order_items.purchase_price, order_items.quantity FROM orders LEFT JOIN ( SELECT order_items.*, products.product_name, products.franchise_name FROM order_items JOIN products ON products.product_id = order_items.product_id ) order_items ON order_items.order_id = orders.order_id JOIN users ON orders.user_id = users.user_id WHERE username = #{username} AND orders.order_status = 'PENDING';
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (user_id) SELECT users.user_id FROM users WHERE username = #{username};
INSERT INTO order_items(order_id, product_id, purchase_price, quantity) VALUES(#{item.orderId}, #{item.productId}, #{item.purchasePrice}, #{item.quantity});
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM order_items WHERE order_id = #{item.orderId} AND product_id = #{item.productId};
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET order_status = #{status}, checkout_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP() WHERE order_id = #{orderId};
mapper.select: SELECT users.username, purchased_items.product_id, products.product_name, products.product_type, products.franchise_id, products.franchise_name FROM purchased_items JOIN users ON purchased_items.user_id = users.user_id JOIN products ON purchased_items.product_id = products.product_id WHERE username = #{username} AND products.product_type in ('GAME', 'DLC');

SELECT orders.order_id, users.username, orders.order_status, orders.total_purchase_price, orders.create_time, order_items.order_item_id, order_items.order_id as order_item_id_order_id, order_items.product_id, order_items.product_name, order_items.franchise_name, order_items.purchase_price, order_items.quantity FROM orders LEFT JOIN ( SELECT order_items.*, products.product_name, products.franchise_name FROM order_items JOIN products ON products.product_id = order_items.product_id ) order_items ON order_items.order_id = orders.order_id JOIN users ON orders.user_id = users.user_id WHERE username = #{username} AND orders.order_status != 'PENDING' ORDER BY create_time DESC;
